title: trench crusade intro
description: give a brief introduction to the lore and setting of trench crusade

script.draft:
I have everything I need. Here is the complete video script:

---

[VISUAL: Close-up of a Templar knight kneeling in shadow beneath the Temple Mount, an ancient glowing artifact pulsing in front of him — dark oil painting style]

It's 1099. The Crusaders have just taken Jerusalem. And then — a handful of Knights Templar do something that ends the world.

Beneath the Holy City's temple, they find an ancient demonic artifact. Blinded by greed, they fell to their knees — and found a new lord. They began trafficking with devils and committing unspeakable rites. This was the First Heresy.

A gate to Hell is torn open. Jerusalem is destroyed in the cataclysm.

That's where Trench Crusade begins.

---

[VISUAL: A vast, ruined warzone stretching to the horizon — gothic trenches crisscrossed with barbed wire, demonic war machines silhouetted against a burning sky — impressionist/grimdark style]

Now jump forward 800 years. The game takes place in 1914 — a version of our world where that single act of betrayal never healed.

For eight centuries, the Church has waged its crusade to reclaim the Holy City. The landscape has been utterly devastated, criss-crossed with thousands of miles of mud, trenches, and craters.

The forces of Hell have conquered one third of humanity — the Middle East, the Balkans, parts of Africa, footholds in Northern Italy, Gibraltar, even Finland.

This is World War One. Except the gas in the trenches is literal brimstone. And what's waiting in No Man's Land is far worse than enemy soldiers.

---

[VISUAL: A collage of faction silhouettes — fanatical pilgrims with molotov cocktails, armored Crusader knights, robed Iron Sultanate warriors, and grotesque demonic Heretic legionnaires — all framed like stained glass]

And the factions? They're extraordinary.

After the First Heresy, humanity splintered into numerous factions roaming the wastes of No Man's Land — the crazed Trench Pilgrims, the Sultanate of the Iron Wall, and the Heretic Legions that serve the very forces of Hell.

The Trench Pilgrims are the mad and the maimed, the God-touched and the guilt-ridden — disorganized groups who follow prophets to the front lines and fight with unrivalled zeal, armed with anything from ancient muskets to Molotov cocktails.

On the other side? A full third of humanity has bent the knee before the idols of Hell, and the Heretic Legions are Satan's main military force on Earth — raised from the citizens of the damned.

---

[VISUAL: A beautifully detailed miniature warband on a painted trench table, lit dramatically from below — cinematic product photography style]

Trench Crusade is a grimdark skirmish miniatures game. It's a collaboration between horror artist Mike Franchina, sculptor James Sherriff, and designer Tuomas Pirinen — whose credits include Diablo IV, Magic: The Gathering, and Mordheim.

The rules are free, and always will be. Small warbands. Deep lore. One of the most original settings in tabletop gaming right now.

If you've ever wanted to crawl out of a trench into literal Hell — this is the game for you. Subscribe, because we're going much, much deeper.

script.description: What if the Knights Templar opened a gate to Hell during the First Crusade — and the world never recovered? Trench Crusade is a grimdark tabletop skirmish game set in an alternate 1914, where humanity has been at war with the forces of Hell for 800 years. In this video, we break down the core lore, the factions, and what makes this setting so unique. If this has you intrigued, like and subscribe — we're diving deep into every faction, warband, and corner of this infernal world.
